navigate_to_named_pose.description: Navigate through a validated route to one named location.

capture_observation.description: Capture RGB data at the indicator station and classify the lamp.

move_arm_to_named_pose.description: Move the arm to one bounded pose in the safe state machine.

get_robot_state.description: Read authoritative location, arm, activity, and stop state.

get_action_status.description: Read a stored action result by action identifier.

stop_robot.description: Cancel motion and return the arm toward home.
